original.statement: The upgrade guide lists running Crossplane v1.20 as a prerequisite for upgrading to Crossplane v2.

corrected.statement: The Crossplane v2 upgrade guide lists running Crossplane v1.20 as a prerequisite, so operators must be on v1.20 before upgrading to v2.0.0.

decision.reason: [ev-924a17cf8cd5] lists "You're running Crossplane v1.20" under the Prerequisites of the v2 upgrade guide, next to other operator preconditions [ev-dac056af4ac4][ev-8e78387c2b06][ev-13abab392283]. That makes it a required operator step (be on v1.20 before upgrading), so the migration family with migration-required is right. A compatibility-boundary doesn't fit, because Crossplane is the product itself, not a platform or managed operand. The name should not repeat the product's name and should be as short as stays clear, so the subject becomes "v1-20-prerequisite".
